proposal.summary: An access control issue in Wavlink WN530HG4 M30HG4.V5030.191116 exposes usernames and passwords by viewing the source of /set_safety.shtml and searching for [var syspasswd].
proposal.cwe_quote: allows attackers to obtain usernames and passwords via view-source:http://IP_ADDRESS/set_safety.shtml?r=52300 and searching for [var syspasswd].

proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce by fetching the page source from a device running the listed firmware and verify presence of credentials; if confirmed, notify vendor PSIRT and recommend removing embedded credentials and implementing proper access controls.
